newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul shares fall to 45-month low on strike fears.
newsitem.headline: Seoul shares fall to 45-month low on strike fears.

text.p: South Korean stocks ended at a 45-month low after fluctuating widely on Saturday as fears of nationwide strikes next week dampened investor sentiment, brokers said.
They said Samsung Electronics was hit by expectations of poor business results for 1996.
"Labour unrest is expected to flare up again from Monday. That expectation prompted the sale of shares today," said Kim Heung-shik of Hyundai Securities.
The composite index closed 10.38 points lower at 643.41, the lowest since March 16, 1993, when it ended at 637.87.
